title: MemoryEvent
description: Base envelope for any event appended to the memory log. SKELETON: this fixes the discriminator and required envelope fields so cross-schema references are stable. Detailed event-type payload schemas land in pr-1.0 (memory.observation, memory.recall, memory.attestation) and pr-1.6 (memory.consolidation references consolidation_event.schema.json).

actor.description: Who/what produced the event. Detailed in pr-1.0.

payload.description: Type-specific payload. See per-event schemas (e.g. consolidation_event.schema.json) for concrete shapes.

lineage.description: Optional list of prior event ids this event derived from.
